story_text: As a registered user, I want to sign in securely so I can access my account.

explicit_ACs.text: The login page shall display an email input field
The login page shall display a password input field
The login page shall allow a user to submit the form
The login page shall show a validation message when credentials are invalid
The login page shall support the forgot password flow

implicit_ACs.text: The login page shall include a password show/hide toggle
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Password entry controls are expected on login screens

implicit_ACs.text: The login page shall include a remember me checkbox
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Login flows commonly include persistent sign-in controls
